blockingFindings.title: R2 repo update and list behavior are only covered by help text
blockingFindings.issue: The R2 test asserts that `plugin repo --help` mentions `repo update` and `repo list`, but no spec-local test executes those repo management commands or verifies that they mutate/report repository state correctly. Help text could pass while the required repo management behavior is unimplemented.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable spec-local coverage for `plugin repo list` and `plugin repo update` against a clean local Git plugin repo, asserting expected state/output after add/update.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 requires plugin repo management, and the current tests only exercise `repo add` plus candidate discovery; `repo update` and `repo list` have no corresponding production-behavior coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R8 workflow plugin extraction test is self-fulfilling
blockingFindings.issue: `R8: workflow command skill and config contributions live in senti-workflow-plugin` creates a temporary compliant workflow plugin fixture and then verifies that same fixture. This would pass even if the real `senti-workflow-plugin` artifact, migrated workflow command, skills, schema/defaults, or official plugin root do not exist.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Change the test to inspect the production workflow plugin artifact/root that implementation is expected to ship, and verify its `plugin.json`, command, skills, config schema/defaults, and flowIntegration support there.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 requires moving workflow functionality out of core into `senti-workflow-plugin`; the current test does not exercise production behavior and can pass without that move.

blockingFindings.title: R8 upgrade coverage depends on a preconfigured workflow repo
blockingFindings.issue: The upgrade test only covers projects that already have a workflow plugin repo configured. R8 requires enabling the workflow plugin for every valid existing project during upgrade, which includes legacy projects without any preexisting plugin repo/package configuration.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local upgrade test for a valid legacy project with no workflow plugin repo/package configured, asserting upgrade installs/enables the official workflow plugin and preserves `workflow.flowIntegration`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could satisfy the current tests by installing from an already configured fixture repo while failing the required migration path for ordinary existing projects.

advisoryFindings.title: R9 source regex is narrow
advisoryFindings.improvement: The `assert.doesNotMatch` check for `workflow: "workflow/index"` only catches one old hardcoding shape. A behavioral assertion that `workflow` is available only through an enabled plugin would be more resilient.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Other R9 tests already exercise disabled plugin command failure, core command precedence, override rejection, and custom plugin dispatch, so this is mainly a robustness improvement.
